title: Act: Create the poller package with Git interface and Poll detection
summary: Add Round, Git, Clock, Result, Poller and Poll that detects SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds
description: Create backend/worker/internal/poller/poller.go. Follow the style of backend/worker/internal/recovery/recovery.go (small interfaces, New constructor, injected now).
acceptance_criteria: Poll returns Scheduled and Closed IDs from the Git fake in list order.

steps.symbol: new: package poller, Status, Round, Git, Closer, Clock, Result
steps.action: Create the file with package doc, Status string constants StatusScheduled, StatusOpen, StatusClosed, struct Round{ID, WorldID string; Status Status; EndsAt time.Time}, interface Git{Pull(ctx) error; ListRounds(ctx, worldID string) ([]Round, error)}, interface Closer{Close(ctx, worldID, roundID string) error}, interface Clock{Now() time.Time}, and struct Result{Scheduled, Closed, ClosedNow []string}.
steps.expected: Types compile and mirror backend/internal/round status names SCHEDULED, OPEN, CLOSED.

steps.action: Add struct Poller{worldID string; git Git; closer Closer; clock Clock}, func New(worldID string, g Git, c Closer, clk Clock) *Poller, and Poll(ctx) (Result, error) that calls p.git.Pull, then p.git.ListRounds(ctx, p.worldID), then loops the Rounds appending r.ID to res.Scheduled when Status==StatusScheduled and to res.Closed when Status==StatusClosed.
steps.expected: Poll returns the detected IDs and a nil error for healthy fakes.
